luke.22.p1.b1.text: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,

luke.22.p1.b2.text: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death; for they feared the people.

luke.22.p1.b3.text: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.

luke.22.p2.b1.text: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.

luke.22.p2.b2.text: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

luke.22.p2.b3.text: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.

luke.22.p3.b1.text: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.

luke.22.p3.b2.text: “Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover.”

luke.22.p3.b3.text: “Where do You want us to prepare it?”

luke.22.p4.b1.text: “When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you.

luke.22.p4.b2.text: Follow him to the house he enters,

luke.22.p4.b3.text: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’

luke.22.p4.b4.text: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”

luke.22.p5.b1.text: So they went and found it just as Jesus had told them. And they prepared the Passover.

luke.22.p5.b3.text: Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles.

luke.22.p6.b1.text: “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.

luke.22.p6.b2.text: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”

luke.22.p7.b1.text: After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said,

luke.22.p7.b2.text: “Take this and divide it among yourselves.

luke.22.p7.b3.text: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.”

luke.22.p8.b1.text: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying,

luke.22.p8.b2.text: “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”

luke.22.p8.b3.text: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying,

luke.22.p8.b4.text: “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.

luke.22.p9.b1.text: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.

luke.22.p9.b2.text: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”

luke.22.p9.b3.text: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.

luke.22.p10.b1.text: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them would be considered the greatest.

luke.22.p10.b2.text: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.

luke.22.p10.b3.text: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves?

luke.22.p10.b4.text: But I am among you as one who serves.

luke.22.p11.b1.text: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.

luke.22.p11.b2.text: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me, so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom,

luke.22.p11.b3.text: and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

luke.22.p12.b2.text: Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.

luke.22.p12.b3.text: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail.

luke.22.p12.b4.text: And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”

luke.22.p13.b1.text: “Lord,” … “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”

luke.22.p13.b3.text: the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”

luke.22.p14.b1.text: “When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?”

luke.22.p14.b2.text: … the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one. For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’

luke.22.p15.b1.text: “Pray that you will not enter into temptation.”

luke.22.p15.b2.text: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me.

luke.22.p15.b3.text: Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”

luke.22.p16.b1.text: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him.

luke.22.p16.b2.text: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly,

luke.22.p16.b3.text: and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.

luke.22.p17.b1.text: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples,

luke.22.p17.b2.text: He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

luke.22.p17.b3.text: “Why are you sleeping?” … “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.”

luke.22.p18.b1.text: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve.

luke.22.p18.b2.text: He approached Jesus to kiss Him.

luke.22.p18.b3.text: “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”

luke.22.p19.b1.text: “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”

luke.22.p19.b2.text: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

luke.22.p19.b4.text: And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.

luke.22.p20.b1.text: “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?

luke.22.p20.b2.text: … But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”

luke.22.p20.b3.text: Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.

luke.22.p20.b4.text: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.

luke.22.p22.b1.text: About an hour later, another man insisted,

luke.22.p22.b2.text: “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”

luke.22.p22.b3.text: “Man, I do not know what you are talking about,”

luke.22.p22.b4.text: While he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.

luke.22.p23.b1.text: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter.

luke.22.p23.b2.text: Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him:

luke.22.p23.b3.text: “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”

luke.22.p23.b4.text: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

luke.22.p24.b1.text: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.

luke.22.p24.b3.text: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.

luke.22.p25.b1.text: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,

luke.22.p25.b2.text: “If You are the Christ, tell us.”

luke.22.p25.b3.text: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

luke.22.p25.b4.text: “Are You then the Son of God?”
